units.previous_finding: Heading "Go en local" reads as running Go locally, but this section is about localized/other-language versions of the Tour. Use a natural Spanish heading that conveys localization/languages and does not overlap semantically with the following "Go sin conexión" page.

The phrase "la sintaxis de expresión `var`=`" is grammatically broken and unnatural Spanish. Restructure the sentence around the protected `var` and `=` identities while preserving the source meaning that type inference applies with := or var-expression syntax.

The retained Go term "slice" uses inconsistent grammatical gender: this page says "las slices" and "una slice", while the established es-ES usage elsewhere is "los slices" and "un slice". Normalize the grammatical gender while keeping the glossary term "slice" unchanged.
